summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying Large and Small Language Models. Built transformer architectures from scratch in PyTorch, compressed a 1.1B-parameter SLM by 55% with under 1% accuracy loss on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC, and deployed generative AI and perception models into distributed services on edge hardware using TensorRT, ONNX, and Hugging Face tooling.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT, an OCR-free vision-language transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; validated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-functional team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced member, restructuring task distribution mid-project to deliver the full pipeline in a 6-week window.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% accuracy degradation and +0.09 perplexity increase, quantifying model efficiency against task performance.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer normalization, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and a custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed a generative AI application across a three-layer distributed pipeline (mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson controller) on a unified WebSocket fabric.

Integrated faster-whisper speech-to-text and Gemini LLM intent classification (under 500ms) with a TensorRT-optimized YOLO model (5.2x speedup, 56.7 ms to 10.9 ms); 100% task reliability over 10 trials.
